summary: Tested the Lex 2.0 financial safeguards, passes and Extra Lex Credits in preview, frontend and backend, with no paid AI calls, no Tavily searches, no Stripe sessions and no Lex messages. Every requested item passed. Unit suites: test_lex2_financial_safeguards.py 17/17 and test_stage3_limits.py 16/16, each run in its own process. A new public-API suite, test_iter52_lex2_safeguards_api.py, passed 10/10. It covers: the admin fair-use view with all 7 new switches False and the proposed and credits blocks present; the admin-only guard; partial patches to monthly_cost_caps and emergency_allowance merging and then being restored; rejection of an unknown tier or emergency_rights_daily=0 with 422; Plus tier copy of 300/40 by default, 150/20 and Pro 350/50 with allowances_v2 on, and back to 300/40 when off; the Day Pass tagline mentioning 30 Lex messages only with passes_v2 on; GET /credits returning enabled=false, balance 0 and 3 packs (25/4.99, 60/9.99, 120/17.99) valid 365 days; checkout returning 403 when off, then with credits on 400 without consent, 400 for an unknown pack and 503 'not configured' with consent and no checkout_url; and 401/403 without login. Customer UI at 390px: the extra-credits-card is hidden when credits are off. With credits on it shows 'Balance: 0 credits' and the 3 credit-pack-* rows; the Buy buttons stay disabled until credit-consent-checkbox is ticked; clicking Buy shows credit-error 'Extra Lex Credits are not configured for payment yet.' and the page does not redirect. Admin UI: admin-fair-use-card shows all 7 new fair-use-switch-* buttons as 'Off'; cost_cap_enabled toggled On and back Off with a 'Saved' toast. Regression: opening the Lex chat as the free user shows fair-use-notice '2 of 2 free Lex questions left.' No page errors. All new switches were confirmed OFF in Mongo at the end, and the test user has 0 credit lots.
critical_code_review_comments: stage3._fallback takes credits from one lot only and needs remaining >= weight. A user with 1 credit left in each of two lots cannot pay for a letter (weight 2) even though the balance shows 2. Consider drawing from several lots, or explain this to the user.

ExtraCreditsCard: when credits are switched off but the user still has a balance, the card shows the balance but no packs. That is fine, but there is no loading or error state if GET /credits fails; the card just stays hidden.
ExtraCreditsCard sets cursor 'pointer' when consent is ticked even while busy. Cosmetic.

Auth (playbook check): bcrypt hashes start with $2b$. The login response returns 'access-control-allow-origin: *' together with allow-credentials true, and auth uses a Bearer token in localStorage rather than an httpOnly cookie. This predates this feature and is noted for awareness only.
server.py is about 17.9k lines (well above the 700-line guideline). This predates this feature.
seed_data_creation: None. Only the fair-use settings were toggled, and every new switch was restored to False (verified in Mongo app_settings._id=stage3). monthly_cost_caps and emergency_allowance were restored to their original values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI login: add_init_script setting sessionStorage aa_skip_marketing=1 and localStorage aa_welcomed=1, aa_lang=en-GB, aa_terms=1, aa_cookie_consent=accepted, aa_uk_scope_ack=1, aa_lex_upl_ack=x; then fill email-input/password-input and click auth-submit-btn. Customer: open-subscribe-btn -> tab-topups-btn (dispatch_event click) -> topups-panel; the ExtraCreditsCard re-fetches /credits when the tab is switched (tab-subs-btn then tab-topups-btn). Admin: settings-btn -> admin-fair-use-card -> fair-use-switch-{key}. Change switches through page.context.request PUT /api/admin/fair-use/settings and always restore all 7 new switches to False in a finally block. POST /api/emergency/rights and /api/lex/chat were NOT called (they cost money).
